name: metamodel.changeStatus
title: Change status definition
summary: Change the name, description, invalid mark or initial mark of a status; only the metamodel files that have them change, line by line, and no element changes its status.
details: Each given field replaces the line of that field in the status's definition, in the file it is in (SR-236 AK3, AK4); a missing field line is added after the definition's last line, and null removes it (false removes a mark; a field that already has the value is left as it is). Every other line stays as it was; no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036), so no element changes its status (D-030, SR-087 AK2), and the key stays (D-043). A status marked initial takes the mark from the status that had it, which may be in another file, so that exactly one status has it (SR-240 AK2). When the invalid mark changes, `elements` counts the elements with the status (D-044). The metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error, such as no initial status, refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no status has the key (details.status); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another status has the name, in Unicode normal form NFC (details.field, details.status); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when a changed definition or a node on the way to it is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

status.description: Key of the status to change.

name.description: New display name; no other status may have it.

description.description: New description, for people; null removes it.

invalid.description: true: elements with the status do not count for coverage and indirect verification, but stay visible in chains (D-044); false removes the mark.

initial.description: true: new elements get the status, and the status that had the mark loses it (SR-240 AK2); false removes the mark, which leaves no initial status and is refused.

status.title: Status
status.description: The definition as it is written afterwards.

previousInitial.title: Previous initial status
previousInitial.description: Key of the status that lost the initial mark; only when the status became initial.

elements.title: Elements with the status
elements.description: The elements that have the status, of any type; only when the invalid mark changed (D-044); those of `elementsWithStatus`.

elementsWithStatus.title: Elements with the status
elementsWithStatus.description: The elements `elements` counts, in store order; only when the invalid mark changed.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4): elements of a type whose counted properties change and that have a value for one of them, such as elements of a type that was unknown before; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
